text: China's grain enterprises reported annual industrial output value above 4 tln yuan and total about 24,000 firms; more than one-third of provinces register output above 100 bln yuan. Annual grain production has remained above 650 mln mt; authorities say 2024 and 2025 will each exc
text_zh: 中国粮食企业年工业总产值超4万亿元，企业总数约2.4万家；超过三分之一的省份产值超千亿元。粮食年产量持续保持在6.5亿吨以上；有关部门表示，2024年和2025年将分别超过此水平
